# Fleet TTS

**Free text-to-speech via [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/) — one Worker, three voices, zero cost beyond the free tier.**

> *The fleet speaks. Not with one voice, but with the right voice for each moment.*

## Vision

The fleet generates a lot of text — agent conversations, story narrations, podcast episodes, [Fleet Radio](https://github.com/SuperInstance/fleet-radio) broadcasts. All of it can be more engaging as audio. But [commercial TTS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speech_synthesis) services charge per character and add up fast at fleet scale.

**Fleet TTS is the free alternative.** It runs on [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/), which includes TTS models in the free tier. Three voice profiles cover the fleet's needs: warm narration, expressive speech, and classic delivery. No API keys, no external dependencies, no cost.

### Design Principles

1. **[Free at scale](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/)** — runs entirely within Workers AI free tier
2. **[OpenAI-compatible](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/audio/createSpeech)** — the `/tts` endpoint accepts the same parameters
3. **[Stateless](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stateless_protocol)** — no database, no KV, no session state. Pure function: text in, audio out.
4. **[Multi-voice](#voices)** — different voices for different agents and contexts

## Quick Start

### Deploy

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SuperInstance/fleet-tts.git
cd fleet-tts
npx wrangler deploy
```

### Use

```bash
# Generate speech
curl "https://fleet-tts.your-subdomain.workers.dev/tts?text=The%20ship%20dreams%20in%20staggered%20triads&voice=aura_en" \
  --output speech.mp3

# List voices
curl "https://fleet-tts.your-subdomain.workers.dev/voices"

# Health check
curl "https://fleet-tts.your-subdomain.workers.dev/health"
```

## API Reference

### `GET /`

Service info and available endpoints.

### `GET /health`

Health check. Returns `{ status: "ok", service: "fleet-tts" }`.

### `GET /voices`

Lists available voice models:

```json
{
  "melotts": "@cf/myshell-ai/melotts",
  "aura_en": "@cf/deepgram/aura-2-en",
  "aura_1": "@cf/deepgram/aura-1"
}
```

### `GET /tts?text=...&voice=...`

Generates speech from text. Returns `audio/mpeg`.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Options |
|-----------|----------|---------|---------|
| `text` | ✅ | — | Any text, URL-encoded (max 5000 chars) |
| `voice` | ❌ | `aura_en` | `melotts`, `aura_en`, `aura_1` |

### Voices

| Key | Model | Character | Best For |
|-----|-------|-----------|----------|
| `melotts` | [`@cf/myshell-ai/melotts`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/melotts/) | Multi-lingual, warm | Stories, narration, non-English text |
| `aura_en` | [`@cf/deepgram/aura-2-en`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/aura-2-en/) | Expressive, natural pacing | Podcasts, agent conversations, primary voice |
| `aura_1` | [`@cf/deepgram/aura-1`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/aura-1/) | Classic Deepgram voice | Short announcements, system messages |

## Key Concepts

### Text-to-Speech (TTS)

[Text-to-speech](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speech_synthesis) converts written text into spoken audio. Modern [neural TTS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neural_network) models produce natural-sounding speech by learning prosody, intonation, and timing from human recordings.

Cloudflare Workers AI hosts several TTS models that run on [GPU infrastructure](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/) at the edge. The first 10,000 neurons of computation per day are free, which covers substantial TTS usage.

### Audio Format

The worker returns `audio/mpeg` ([MP3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MP3)) — the most widely supported audio format. MP3 is playable in every browser, media player, and audio editing tool.

### Text Length Limit

Cloudflare Workers AI limits TTS input to 5000 characters per request. For longer texts, split into multiple requests and concatenate the audio files.

## Configuration

### `wrangler.toml`

```toml
name = "fleet-tts"
main = "worker.js"
compatibility_date = "2024-09-25"

[ai]
binding = "AI"
```

The `[ai]` binding gives the Worker access to [Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/) models. No API key needed — Cloudflare authenticates via the account.

### Environment

No environment variables required. The Worker is completely stateless.

## Testing

```bash
# Run tests
npm test              # vitest run

# Watch mode
npm run test:watch

# Manual test
npx wrangler dev      # Start local dev server
curl "http://localhost:8784/tts?text=Hello%20world&voice=aura_en" --output test.mp3
```

Tests cover:
- Voice parameter validation
- Text length limit enforcement
- Error handling for missing text
- CORS header presence
- Response content-type verification

---

## Deployment

```bash
npx wrangler deploy
```

The worker deploys to `https://fleet-tts.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev`. It's a single `worker.js` file — no build step.

### Custom Domain

Configure in the [Cloudflare dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) under Workers → Routes → Add Custom Domain.
